_meta.origin: Ninja Inkflow CE US and UK Spelling Database

entries.applies_when: The found form is not accepted by the document’s dictionary and the other form is.
entries.notes: Safe to apply automatically outside masked text.

entries.applies_when: The two forms differ by meaning or part of speech.
entries.message_template: {found} may be correct, depending on meaning or part of speech. Check against {suggestion}.
entries.notes: Severity is info when the found form is itself valid in the document’s dictionary, otherwise warning.

entries.applies_when: The document’s dictionary also accepts the found form.
entries.message_template: {found} is accepted in {doc_region} English. {suggestion} is the {doc_region} alternative.
entries.notes: Hidden unless min_severity is info. Apply only if house style requires it.

entries.applies_when: Both forms are accepted in the document’s variety.
entries.notes: Use for consistency checks within a document.

entries.applies_when: The pair follows the documented pattern but is not in the dictionary word lists.
entries.message_template: {found} follows the {doc_region} pattern for {suggestion}, but the pair is not dictionary-checked.
entries.notes: Never autocorrect. Review before promoting to dictionary_checked or verified.

entries.applies_when: The record is marked disputed, so the form cannot be corrected automatically in either direction.
entries.message_template: {found} is not the usual {doc_region} spelling, but the record is disputed. Suggested form: {suggestion}.
entries.notes: Never autocorrect. Review the record and the house style.

entries.applies_when: Document variant is en-GB-oxendict and an -ise form is found.
entries.message_template: {found} is the -ise form. Oxford spelling uses {suggestion}.
entries.notes: Applies only to the IZE_ISE pattern. The -yse verbs are unchanged.

entries.applies_when: A document contains definite US forms and definite UK forms.
entries.message_template: This document mixes US and UK spellings ({us_forms} US, {uk_forms} UK). Examples: {examples}.
entries.notes: Document-level message. Use it to confirm the intended variant.

entries.applies_when: The span matches an entry in Protected_Terms or the document’s own protected names.
entries.notes: Masks the span before lookup. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.
